M01-F01.name: 平台身份与选择

reference.rule: Compare supported behavior, not a whitelist of tested TP/DP/PP combinations; preserve vendor engine arguments.

exclusions: Unmeasured hardware/topologies and vendor-native failures are not certified by this feature.

cases.name: 平台身份与选择
cases.native_control: Same model revision, engine parameters, workload and topology; paired raw outputs required where parity is asserted.

retry.policy: Diagnose first; never hide an earlier failure.

acceptance_notes: Assertions require independently observed evidence, not copied constants or a generic passed flag.
For a capability with multiple native backends, choose a supported backend in campaign scope; do not require every vendor to implement every transport.
